methodology: Each source scans on its own schedule and is ranked WITHIN itself. There is deliberately no cross-source score: a crypto arb in basis points, an earnings yield and a contract cadence are not commensurable, and one combined leaderboard over them would be invented. Every section carries its own caveat; read it before the numbers. Nothing here is advice, and none of it is an executed trade.
